brief: Holds a skill read from a declaration as three data clauses and runs them against an agent memory.
detail: A closure cannot be read out of a file, so this skill keeps its when, does and verify clauses as lists of a verb and its arguments and interprets them. Apply checks the precondition, performs the action on the memory it is given and verifies the result, answering a list that says whether it ran and whether it verified.
receiver:
m = new stzAgentMemory("demo")
m.Learn("stock", "level", "low")
o1 = new stzDeclaredSkill("restock")
o1.SetClauses([ :verb = "fact", :args = [ "stock", "level", "low" ] ], [ :verb = "learn", :args = [ "stock", "level", "ordered" ] ], [ :verb = "fact", :args = [ "stock", "level", "ordered" ] ])
